patch.value: Audit every generated release claim against recorded evidence

Emit deterministic claim-to-resolution, tests and delivery map. Overlap: pm CLI 2026.10.21 has no generated-wording audit; pm-changelog classifier chooses sections and entry lint warns on prose; pm-review validates review evidence; pm-ops validates publication provenance. This feature links generated wording to recorded evidence only. Reconciliation PR 266 items excluded.

A factual closure without repair evidence cannot justify Fixed; absent evidence remains an explicit gap; ordering and regeneration are deterministic.; Typed SDK and CLI; compact TOON/JSON; typed refusals with remedies; README and example; no-git regression; read-only public tracker validation; npm and Bun CI release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: capture exact rendered claim lines through the shared generator, hash generated markdown, deduplicate item evidence, and retain absent resolution/tests/test-result/delivery as explicit gaps. Linked test declarations never imply success; caller-supplied execution receipts require matching commands and retain references. Factual closures preserve classifier-neutral wording. SDK assertions and CLI check refuse unsupported claims. CI will execute full npm and Bun release gates on both supported Node versions; local work uses targeted tests only.
